hints.title: Round-Robin Stream Interleaving
hints.text: Alternating between multiple non-empty collections in sequential rounds models fair scheduling across active streams.

hints.title: First-In First-Out Active Vector Rotation
hints.text: Maintain active vectors along with their current read indices. Pop the head stream, emit its current element, and re-enqueue if unread items remain.

hints.title: Rotating Cursor Blueprint
hints.text: Store tuples of (list, index) in a double-ended buffer. In next(), popleft(), retrieve list[index], and if index + 1 < len(list), append (list, index + 1). In hasNext(), check whether buffer is non-empty.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: K: number of input vectors (here K = 2)
complexity.notes: Both next() and hasNext() run in amortized O(1) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Flattening both lists entirely upfront consumes extra memory and does not generalize to infinite streams.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Holding only active stream references and cursor indices minimizes auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Design that naturally scales from 2 vectors to k vectors without structural changes.
